title: Collapsible workspace sidebar, light and dark glass versions (Vitaliy D.)
contains_third_party_content: Photo avatar and third-party service logos (Jira, Slack, Intercom) appear in the mockup.
grouping_note: Two images appear to be one concept in two themes. User to confirm.

color.method: Pixel sampling via median-cut quantization of the supplied JPEG/GIF (compressed images, so values are approximate within a few units). Entries marked 'approx' were judged by eye, not sampled.
palette: active pill and FAB blue (saturated-pixel median)
green edge indicator for active row
color.roles: Same layout in two themes: light uses blue as the active-state color; dark uses a bright green edge marker and blue FAB.

observed.layout: Two panels side by side: expanded sidebar and a collapsed icon-only rail. Sections: greeting + avatar, 'Menu: 6' (Dashboard, My project task, Calendar, Mail, Notification, Sales), 'Service: 3' (Jira, Slack, Intercom, add plugin) in a white/dark inset card, 'Settings: 6' as a row of icons in a pill, and a large 'Create new task' card with a round + button. A collapse chevron sits at the top edge.
observed.hierarchy: Sections labeled with counts. Active row is a solid blue pill (light) or has a lit label plus a green edge tick (dark). The round + button is the primary CTA in both.
observed.typography: Clean sans with strong weight contrast: bold greeting name, medium row labels, small grey section headers (Inter/Manrope-like; unconfirmed).
observed.iconography: Filled duotone-like icons, consistent size, in the same grey-blue; service logos in color.
observed.materials: Frosted glass panels with inset solid cards, soft shadows; wallpaper bloom visible through glass.
observed.background: Blue bloom wallpaper (light) and pink bloom wallpaper (dark); both resemble Windows 11 Bloom wallpapers (unverified).

interpretation.aesthetic: Soft modern glassmorphism with a productivity-app purpose.
implementation_notes: Collapsed rail keeps the same icon order and inset-card structure, so collapse is a width transition with labels fading.
Counts in section headers act as quick metadata.
Dark theme replaces the filled-pill active state with a thin lit marker, a sign that the active treatment is theme-specific.

concept_work.essence: One information architecture that survives both a wide and a collapsed state and both a light and a dark theme.
what_makes_it_work: Clear grouping with solid inset cards on top of glass improves legibility where glass alone would not.
The rail preserves position memory: same order, same icons.
gaps_to_make_it_work: Light-glass grey text on pale panels is low contrast.
Settings icon row in the rail truncates ('chevron down') with no shown overflow behavior.
Collapsed state needs tooltips (not shown here).

lessons: Put solid cards inside glass for dense or critical content.
Design the collapsed state at the same time as the expanded state.
